title: Watch the teaser trailer for ‘Beast Games’ Season 3, coming to Prime Video December 16
summary: MrBeast's competition series goes global, with competitors from 196 nations battling for $5 million.
body_markdown:
---


Key takeaways


- Beast Games


Season 3 premieres December 16 with three episodes, then two a week until the finale.


- Players from 196 nations compete for $5 million across global stages, including the Roman Colosseum.


- The show streams only on Prime Video in more than 240 countries and territories.


---


MrBeast's record-breaking competition show is going worldwide.


Titled


Beast Games: World Champions


,


the third season brings together contestants from 196 nations, each competing for their nation and a $5 million prize.


[How to watch 'Beast Games' Season 2 on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/mr-beast-prime-video-season-2-beast-games)


MrBeast’s competition series returns with 200 participants battling in a ‘Strong vs. Smart’ showdown for $5 million.


The new season takes place on a global stage including the Roman Colosseum, a stadium packed with tens of thousands of live audience members, and all-new challenges.


The first season of


[Beast Games](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/beast-games-mrbeast-prime-video) became Prime Video's most-watched unscripted show ever, reaching 50 million viewers in its first 25 days.


Here's everything you need to know about Season 3 of


Beast Games


, including how to watch.


## How can I watch 'Beast Games' Season 3?


Beast Games: World Champions


will stream exclusively on Prime Video in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide.


The season premieres Wednesday, December 16, with three episodes. Two new episodes follow each week until the one-episode season finale on Wednesday, January 13.


You can watch the previous two seasons of


Beast Games


on Prime Video now.


Prime Video is included in your


[Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) , which costs $14.99 a month or $139 a year in the United States.


Discounted memberships are also available for


[young adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) and qualifying


[government assistance](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) recipients at 50% off.


Please check your local Amazon website for Prime membership pricing in your region.


Not a member yet? Start a 30-day


[free trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) today.


## What is 'Beast Games'?


Beast Games


is a competition series from YouTube star MrBeast.


The show sees large groups of contestants compete in challenges for a life-changing cash prize.


In Season 1, 1,000 players competed for a prize that grew to $10 million, making it the biggest reality competition series ever.


[Season 2](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/mr-beast-prime-video-season-2-beast-games) cut the field to 200 players in a "Strong vs. Smart" showdown, which included a special


Survivor


crossover episode.


With Season 3, the show goes global. MrBeast brings together competitors from around the world, each representing their nation in the battle for $5 million.


Strength, skill, and strategy challenges push every player to their limit. Bribes, betrayals, and twists show how far contestants will go for the money.


Alliances cross borders, rivalries split continents, and only one player will be crowned the


Beast Games


world champion.


[How to watch live sports like the NBA, NFL, and more on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/live-sports-streaming-prime-video)


Prime members can also watch New York Yankees, Duke men's basketball, NWSL, and regional NHL games in 2026.


Jimmy Donaldson returns as host and executive producer. Tyler Conklin co-created the series with Donaldson and returns as executive producer as well as series director. Michael H. Miller, Rob Buchta, Chris Keiper, Josh Kulic, Michael Cruz, and Jeff Housenbold also serve as executive producers.


## Who is MrBeast?


Jimmy Donaldson, known around the world as MrBeast, has more than 527 million YouTube subscribers on his main channel.


Time


named him one of its 100 most influential people in 2023.


Beyond making videos, he founded Beast Philanthropy, a charity that has given away tens of millions of free meals, as well as running charitable projects around the world.


## What else can I watch on Prime Video?


Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices.


Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports.


These include Amazon MGM Studios–produced series and movies, licensed fan favorites, and programming through


[subscriptions on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/what-are-prime-video-channels) such as Paramount+,


[MGM+](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/everything-you-need-to-know-about-mgm-plus) ,


[Apple TV](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/apple-tv-shows-amazon-prime-video-subscription) ,


[HBO Max](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/hbo-max-on-prime-video-channels) , Peacock, FOX One,


[DAZN](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/prime-video-dazn-sports-subscription) , and Crunchyroll, as well as more than 900 free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels in the U.S.


All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.
